ActionNode.description:
Plugin-defined command (e.g. "Max all items"). Parameters are rendered as a small form; their
string FieldNode.ValueId is the parameter name passed to ActionOutcome ISaveDocument.InvokeAction(string actionId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, FieldValue> parameters).

confirm.description: When set, the browser asks for confirmation with this text first.

mutates.description: False opts into isolated, verified inspection. Results are messages, never save or view changes.

parameters.description: Typed input fields whose values supply defaults and whose IDs become parameter names.

selectionTableId.description:
Optional table selection binding for planned actions: an eager TableNode.SelectionId or F8 CollectionId
in the same view. Null preserves placement-based scope. A bound sibling with no selection uses document scope.
Member adapters map this identity with the table identity. This does not declare value ownership.

supportsPlanning.description: Requires IActionPlanningDocument; direct invocation is rejected. False preserves legacy behavior.

ActionPlan.description: Deterministic preview of ordered consequences and diagnostics, calculated without mutating the document.

changes.description: Every proposed direct and derived consequence in deterministic order.

errors.description: Validation failures that prevent the plan from being applied.

skippedRows.description: Selected rows that cannot or need not change, with their reasons.

warnings.description: Limitations and notices to review before applying.

ActionQueryScope.description: A revision-bound selection of every matching row, including pages never loaded by the client.

excludedRowKeys.description: Stable row keys to omit from the complete matching result, including unloaded pages.

ActionScope.description:
Selection for a planned action. A null scope, including an omitted HTTP scope, means document
scope; a non-null empty row-key list means that no rows are selected. Query scopes are resolved by
Core and the returned scope contains the normalized selection.

oneOf.description: Optional whole-query selection. Core supplies both this and the resolved RowKeys to plugins.

BoolSpec.description: A Boolean field accepting only true or false.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

ColumnWidth.description: Relative presentation hint for a table column; the host chooses concrete dimensions.

DateTimeSpec.description: ISO-8601 timestamp text. Set bool DateTimeSpec.HasTimeZone false for local/unknown-zone clocks.

hasTimeZone.description: True validates an offset-aware timestamp; false retains an unspecified local clock.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

EmptyRowPresentation.description: Optional presentation of explicitly marked empty slots; never changes saved data or row identities.

hideByDefault.description: Initially hides confirmed empty slots while retaining their data and stable identities.

labelColumnKey.description: Column whose compact cell displays "Empty slot"; the original remains in row details.

pluralLabel.description: Human plural label used by the visibility toggle.

EnumOption.description: A stable raw option value and its display label; labels are never written to the save.

description.description: Optional explanation or attribution for this option.

EnumSpec.description:
One-of choice. The value is the option's string EnumOption.Value as text.
With bool EnumSpec.AllowCustom, values outside the list are accepted (useful for partially
mapped hash IDs); the plugin must then validate them itself.

allowCustom.description: Accepts raw values outside the published list; native-format validation remains the plugin's responsibility.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

ExactNumberSpec.description: A JSON number lexeme, preserved byte-for-byte rather than converted to a machine number.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound as an exact JSON number lexeme, or null for no bound.

maxAbsoluteExponent.description: Maximum absolute exponent, without expanding exponent zeros.

maxLength.description: Maximum lexeme length, bounded by the exact-number validator's hard limit.

min.description: Inclusive bounds, themselves JSON number lexemes. Comparisons use exact decimal arithmetic.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

ExternalViewLink.description: An attributed link, never an image URL, iframe, tile source or fetch instruction. HTTPS only.

FieldError.description: A user-facing rejection associated with a field or action ID; an empty ID denotes a general error.

FieldNode.description:
A single value bound to string FieldNode.ValueId. Value ids must be stable for the document's lifetime
and unique within it; the framework routes edits by id and validates them against FieldSpec FieldNode.Spec.

value.description: FieldSpec determines the value type. Integers use decimal strings to preserve Int128 precision.

warning.description: Shown next to the control, e.g. "Values above 999 may crash the game".

FieldSpec.description:
Describes the data type and constraints of an editable value. The browser picks a control from the
spec; plugins never choose widgets or styling. The framework validates every incoming edit against
the spec before the plugin sees it.

FieldValue.description: FieldSpec determines the value type. Integers use decimal strings to preserve Int128 precision.

FlagBit.description: A named zero-based bit position within a FlagsSpec integer.

description.description: Optional explanation of the named bit's meaning.

FlagsSpec.description: Bit set stored as an integer value; unnamed bits are preserved by the browser.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

FloatFormat.description: Display format for a floating-point value, with optional elapsed-time presentation.

FloatSpec.description: A finite floating-point field with optional inclusive bounds and float32 rounding.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, or null for no additional bound.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound, or null for no additional bound.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

singlePrecision.description: True when the stored value is float32, so the browser can round accordingly.

unitsPerSecond.description: Raw units per second for Duration; defaults to seconds. Must be finite and positive.

GameTitle.description: A supported title and its human game name; list regional title IDs separately.

GraphEdge.description: From is a prerequisite of To. Cycles and missing endpoints are rejected.

GraphItem.description: A stable prerequisite item with optional explanatory cost, branch and navigation metadata.

branch.description: Optional branch label for grouping and filtering.

cost.description: Display-only cost; the framework does not enforce a resource budget.

GraphNode.description:
Bounded, read-only prerequisite DAG. TextAlternative describes the diagram; the browser always
supplies a full text list of items, states, costs, prerequisites and targets alongside it.
Split larger graphs into regional/branch nodes or lazy sections; see SpatialViewLimits.

GraphState.description: Known unlock state of a prerequisite item; Unknown does not imply locked or unavailable.

HexNode.description: Read-only byte view served in pages by ReadOnlyMemory<byte> ISaveDocument.ReadBlob(string blobId, long offset, int count).

title.description: Optional heading for the byte view.

ImageNode.description: Image served by AssetContent? ISaveDocument.GetAsset(string assetId).

IntegerFormat.description: Display format for an integer; the underlying value remains an exact integer.

IntegerSpec.description: An exact integer constrained by inclusive minimum and maximum bounds.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

unitsPerSecond.description: For IntegerFormat.Duration: raw units per second (e.g. 1_000_000 for µs).

MapBackground.description:
Local F2 asset (packId:path), never a remote URL. EmbeddingPermitted is the plugin author's explicit
assertion that the asset licence permits embedding. An unclear licence requires ExternalSource instead.

MapBounds.description: Display bounds after transformation. X increases rightwards; Y increases downwards.

MapMarker.description: A stable map location, optionally positioned or linked to an existing control or attributed source.

description.description: Optional explanation or attribution for the location and its status.

x.description: Native coordinates; omit both for an external-only or not-yet-mapped location.

y.description: Native vertical coordinate; set or omit together with X.

MapMarkerStatus.description: Known discovery state of a map location; Unknown is distinct from a confirmed missing location.

MapNode.description:
Bounded, read-only map with a mandatory text summary and an always-available marker list.
Default: link to ExternalSource and omit artwork/coordinates. Embedded coordinates require full
provenance and an explicit permission assertion, including original schematic/save-derived data.

coordinateEmbeddingPermitted.description: Explicit plugin-author assertion that embedding the attributed coordinates is permitted.

coordinateSpace.description: Human-readable name for the native coordinate system.

MapTransform.description: Display position = native position * scale + offset, separately for each axis.

NullableSpec.description: Explicit null or a value conforming to Inner. Null never means a missing property.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

PlannedChange.description: Named, game-level consequences. Null before/after means absence only when the corresponding Exists flag is false.

derived.description: True for a consequence of another edit; the plugin decides which consequences require actual assignments.

newExists.description: False when the action removes the field, distinct from assigning null.

oldExists.description: False when the field did not exist before the action, distinct from an existing null value.

PluginMaturity.description: Evidence level for the plugin's ability to write saves that load in-game.

PresetAction.description: One action configuration persisted by a toolkit preset.

PresetActionCapability.description: Published action metadata a plugin is willing to capture or apply through presets.

PresetCapability.description: Optional plugin capability for semantic preset capture, instance resolution and atomic apply.

PresetCompatibility.description: Stable title, plugin and optional game-build identity used by an external toolkit preset.

PresetInstanceReference.description: A semantic instance reference. Stable ids are supplied by a plugin; session ids are forbidden.

QueryableCollectionQuery.description: Text, exact column filters and deterministic paging/sorting for a collection.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token. A request uses either this or int QueryableCollectionQuery.Offset.

descending.description: Requests descending sorting; use a stable identity tie-break in either direction.

filters.description: Exact filters keyed by declared column keys; apply them before visibility filtering and paging.

includeEmpty.description:
Null uses collection EmptyRows.HideByDefault; legacy collections include all rows.
            Filter emptiness on the complete model before paging. Core supplies the resolved value.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, between one and int QueryableCollectionLimits.MaxPageSize.

offset.description: Zero-based position among matching visible rows; must be zero when using a cursor.

sortColumn.description: Declared column key to sort by, or null for deterministic native ordering.

text.description: Optional free-text search over the collection's searchable model projections.

QueryableColumn.description: A typed column in a queryable collection. Cells still carry their complete view node.

QueryableTableNode.description: Metadata emitted in the document view to select the server-backed table renderer.

description.description: Optional collection explanation or attribution, matching the collection metadata.

ReferenceAttribution.description:
Who made a dataset and under which terms it may be used. Every dataset in a pack carries one;
the UI shows it wherever the data appears (see rule 9 in docs/PLUGIN_GUIDE.md).

author.description: Author, project or community, e.g. "Fextralife wiki contributors".

license.description: Licence name or SPDX id, e.g. "CC-BY-SA-4.0".

modifications.description: What was changed or extracted ("None" when used verbatim).

sourceUrl.description: Where the data was taken from (http/https).

ReferenceCandidate.description: A raw id plus display metadata and resolved record/icon provenance. Unknown ids have no label.

oneOf.description: Separate provenance of the image dataset, when available.
Provenance of the resolved record dataset.

eligibility.description: Resolved field-specific selection policy and reasons.

label.description: Resolved display name, or null for an unknown raw ID.

ReferenceCandidatePage.description: A bounded, field-specific page. Revision binds candidates to the view used to query them.

sortKeys.description: Sort keys supported by the pinned catalog.

ReferenceDatasetInfo.description: One attributed dataset of a pack: a records catalog or a set of assets.

itemCount.description: Records or assets in the dataset.

ReferenceDatasetKind.description: The content category of an attributed reference-pack dataset.

ReferenceEligibility.description: Availability in this build/save and eligibility for this field. Reasons explain restrictions.

available.description: Whether this candidate is available in the current build or save.

eligible.description: Whether this candidate is suitable for this field under plugin policy.

reasons.description: User-facing reasons for restrictions or uncertainty.

selectable.description: True only when the candidate is both available and eligible.

ReferencePackInfo.description: Identity of a loaded reference pack.

contentFingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of the validated manifest and every listed file hash.

datasets.description: Attributed record and asset datasets supplied by this pack.

description.description: Optional explanation of the pack's contents and limitations.

gameBuilds.description: Game builds the pack was made for. Empty: build-agnostic.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag such as "en" or "de-DE"; null for language-neutral data.

pluginIds.description: Plugins that may use the pack.

titleIds.description: Titles the pack applies to. Empty: every title the plugins open.

ReferencePackOrigin.description: Where a reference pack came from.

ReferenceSortKey.description: Catalog sort keys; callers may request only keys declared by the catalog.

ReferenceSpec.description:
A catalog-backed choice. The field value is the exact raw id as text, including unknown current
ids. Catalog metadata is resolved on demand rather than embedding every option in the view.

allowCustom.description: Allow new ids absent from the pinned catalog. Known candidates still obey eligibility.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

SectionNode.description:
Titled group of nodes. When string? SectionNode.LazyId is set, IReadOnlyList<ViewNode> SectionNode.Children is ignored and the
browser fetches the children via IReadOnlyList<ViewNode> ISaveDocument.ExpandNode(string lazyId) once the section is opened.

badge.description: Short secondary label, e.g. an item count.

collapsed.description: Initial collapsed state; users can expand the section.

lazyId.description: Stable expansion ID passed to the document instead of eagerly reading Children.

SkippedActionRow.description: A selected row left unchanged, with a user-facing explanation.

Stat.description: A formatted, read-only headline value and its label.

hint.description: Optional explanation of the displayed statistic.

StatsNode.description: Read-only headline figures, e.g. play time, level, slot.

Tab.description: One named page of a tab group, containing ordinary view nodes.

TableColumn.description: An eager table's stable column key and human label; row cells use the same key.

TableNode.description: Homogeneous records (inventory, party members, ...). The browser handles paging, search and virtualisation.

selectionId.description: Optional stable selection identity, unique among eager SelectionIds and F8 CollectionIds in this view.

TableRow.description: Row of a table. Cells are keyed by column key and are usually FieldNode or TextNode.

isEmpty.description: Confirmed empty slot, not an unknown item or merely a zero quantity. Its key and cells remain intact.

TabsNode.description: A group of named pages; all child bindings remain part of the same document.

TextNode.description: Read-only text, optionally styled by semantic tone or rendered in a fixed-width font.

monospace.description: Render in a fixed-width font (hashes, offsets, ids).

TextSpec.description: A text field with an optional UTF-16 length bound and explicit line-break policy.

maxLength.description: Maximum length in UTF-16 code units, or null for unbounded.

multiline.description: Allows carriage returns and line feeds; false requires a single line.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

Tone.description: Semantic emphasis for text and actions; the host supplies the visual styling.

UnionOption.description: A named type choice. Id is stable and unique within the enclosing union.

UnionSpec.description:
An explicit choice among inner specs. Values use FieldValue.Union(optionId, value), so choices
with identical scalar wire shapes (such as integer and text) stay distinguishable.
Wrap in NullableSpec to allow a null independently of the chosen type.

readOnly.description: Prevents edits through the host while preserving the field's value and display metadata.

ValueChange.description: A value that changed; FieldValue ValueChange.OldValue enables undo.

ViewNode.description:
Abstract, style-free description of what to show. Plugins compose these nodes; the browser decides
how each node type looks. Keep trees reasonably small: wrap large or deep content in a lazy
SectionNode so it is only built when the user opens it.

ViewTarget.description:
Navigation only: never invokes an action or edits a field. Path opens enclosing containers using
section:<lazyId or title>, tab:<title>, row:<key>. Row targets name the row in its parent table.
Queryable rows must already be loaded; this contract does not issue searches for target ids.

path.description: Enclosing section, tab and row path components in root-to-target order.

ViewTargetKind.description: The kind of existing control or row reached by a navigation target.

requestBody.description: File-part names are unrestricted; 'files' is illustrative. Exactly one reference-pack ZIP.
File-part names are unrestricted; 'files' is illustrative. One or more decrypted ZIPs or loose files; optional name.
